neighbours.label: The linking word right after a promotional reward (bonus points, free gift, voucher) at the point where the qualifying condition is due: 'bonus points after you spend', 'free with any order', 'voucher for those who'; quiet on the same words after ordinary nouns and on fees
fire: New cardholders receive 60,000 bonus points after spending $4,000 in the first three months.
This week you get a free travel mug with every purchase of two bags of coffee.
Open a savings account today and earn a $150 bonus with a deposit of $10,000 or more.
The shop handed out a $20 gift card for each customer who traded in an old phone.
Members collect double reward points on all orders placed before Sunday.
Sign up now and claim 50 free spins with your first deposit.
The airline offers a free companion ticket after you fly ten times in a year.
Subscribers get a bonus e-book with any annual plan.
quiet: New cardholders pay a $60 yearly fee and 2% on purchases made abroad.
This week she bought a travel mug with a picture of a lighthouse on it.
Open the window today and let some air in after the rain.
The shop was full of old phones for people who repair them.
Members meet in the hall on all Sundays before Easter.
He signed the form and left with his first payslip.
The airline cancelled the flight after a storm closed the airport.
Subscribers read the paper with their morning coffee.

notes: Card: ' with', ' for', ' after', ' on', ' without' following a bonus, a free item or a gift certificate; the output promotes ' purchase', ' buy', ' purchases'. Probes: 'bonus miles after you spend' 1.04, 'free tote bag with any order' 1.17, '$100 bonus with promo code' 1.10, 'voucher for everyone who' 0.65; 'annual fee of $95' 0.11, 'tote bag with a broken strap' 0.00.
